tasks.label: android: install debug apk, launch app, forward jdwp
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $adb = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $adb)) { $adb = 'adb' }; ./gradlew.bat :app:installDebug; & $adb wait-for-device; & $adb shell am force-stop com.spop.poverlay; & $adb shell am start -D -n com.spop.poverlay/.MainActivity; $appPid = $null; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 40 -and -not $appPid; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250; $appPid = (& $adb shell pidof com.spop.poverlay).Trim() }; if (-not $appPid) { throw 'Could not find com.spop.poverlay on the connected Android device.' }; & $adb forward tcp:8700 jdwp:$appPid; Write-Host "Forwarded com.spop.poverlay JDWP process $appPid to localhost:8700"
